key_insight: WEQA uses a query-adaptive agent to combine LLM reasoning with wearable-specific analytics and models, making wearable health question answering more accurate and grounded.
engineering_relevance: The work provides a practical blueprint for building robust, multimodal health agents that can route different user queries to the right sensor-analysis tools and pretrained models.
method: LLM controller synthesizes execution plans from the user query.
Dynamically routes to specialized wearable analytical and predictive tools.
Performs grounded response auditing with external knowledge.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on a new benchmark across four open wearable datasets, three health domains, and both analytic and predictive tasks; the abstract reports 24% better accuracy than LLM and agentic baselines plus positive blinded feedback from 12 medical experts and 8 users.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality and availability of task-specific wearable tools, external knowledge, and careful routing across heterogeneous sensor modalities.
paper_title: WEQA: Wearable hEalth Question Answering with Query-Adaptive Agentic Reasoning
